title: Compounding Schedule by Row Size for Distribution-Margin Rows Retired Early (Capital Credits)
content:
# Compounding Schedule by Row Size — Distribution-Margin Rows Retired Early

**Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) schedule.** The early discount on a distribution-margin row retired under an approved discounted early retirement is compounded by the size of the row's gross:

| Gross of the row | Compounding | Rate per period | Periods |
|---|---|---|---|
| under $100.00 | monthly | one twelfth of the adjusted rate | twelve for each year of the horizon |
| at least $100.00 and under $250.00 | twice a year | one half of the adjusted rate | two for each year of the horizon |
| $250.00 or more | once a year | the full adjusted rate | one for each year of the horizon |

**Gross of the row.** The allocated amount of that distribution-margin allocation year as booked, less every general retirement already booked on that allocation year and source, rounded to the cent. The size test is made on that gross.

**Discount for a period count.** One plus the rate per period, written as a decimal, is raised to the power of the number of periods (which may include a fraction of a year where the horizon does); the discounted value is the amount divided by that result.

## Size boundaries

| Gross | Compounding |
|---|---|
| $99.99 | monthly |
| $100.00 | twice a year |
| $249.99 | twice a year |
| $250.00 | once a year |

## Worked figures (hypothetical rate of 7 percent and horizon of 4 years)

| Gross | Compounding | Discounted value |
|---|---|---|
| $80.00 | monthly: one plus 0.07 divided by twelve, raised to the power 48 | $60.51 |
| $180.00 | twice a year: one plus 0.035, raised to the power 8 | $136.69 |
| $600.00 | once a year: 1.07 raised to the power 4 | $457.74 |
